quotes.title: HD 45350
quotes.card: HD 45350 is a solar analog star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Auriga.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of 7.89, which means it is an 8th magnitude star that is too dim to be readily visible to the naked eye.
